title: Sinkhorn Based Associative Memory Retrieval Using Spherical Hellinger Kantorovich Dynamics
summary: We propose a dense associative memory for empirical measures (weighted point clouds). Stored patterns and queries are finitely supported probability measures, and retrieval is defined by minimizing a Hopfield-style log-sum-exp energy built from the debiased Sinkhorn divergence. We derive retrieval dynamics as a spherical Hellinger Kantorovich (SHK) gradient flow, which updates both support locations and weights.
